faq.title: What's changing at WonderMoney
faq.intro: A quick explanation, and where things stand.
faq.q1Body: We're a bootstrapped, two-person team. User acquisition in personal finance is expensive, and it hasn't grown as fast as we hoped. On top of that, open banking connections and commercial financial-data APIs cost real money per user — and at our current volume of paying customers, we can no longer cover that cost while keeping the quality bar we set for ourselves.
faq.q2Body: No. We still believe in WonderMoney — it's one of the few genuinely all-in-one personal finance apps built in the EU. We're changing how it's funded, not ending it.
faq.q3Body: We're moving to a free, open-source, bring-your-own-key (BYOK) model. Instead of WonderMoney paying for your bank connections and market data behind the scenes, you'll be able to connect your own API keys from supported providers, which we'll list with setup guides. That lets you run WonderMoney for free, for personal use.
faq.q4Title: What happens to my current account?
faq.q4Body: Your data is safe and untouched. WonderMoney is now free for everyone — there are no trials or subscriptions any more, so every account has full access.
faq.q5Title: Can you recommend another app instead?
faq.q5Body: Honestly, we can't — we built WonderMoney because we couldn't find another all-in-one app that did what it does, and we still haven't.
faq.q6Body: Reach out any time at {email} — we read everything.
